topic: Asking the Groomer to Fix a Shaggy Dog Cut

script.title: THE PUPPY CUT FIX
script.scene_zh: 寵物美容店 · 補救造型
script.story_hook: A lion walk home needs a gentle rescue.
script.intro_zh: 頂著獅子造型走回家，需要一場溫柔的救援。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the grooming salon. Listen for fix-it and comfort phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到寵物美容店。留意補救與安撫相關的說法。
script.outro: And that's one shaggy mistake fixed. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一團凌亂的毛就這樣修好了。再聽一次，跟著複誦。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready to repeat each line with me?
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好跟我一起逐句跟讀了嗎？
script.char_a_description: a cheerful man in his late twenties with medium curly chestnut hair, light stubble, a mustard yellow henley shirt with rolled sleeves, a retractable leash in hand, and a solid build
script.char_b_description: a sturdy woman in her thirties with dark hair pulled into a tight bun under a navy bandana, safety glasses pushed up on her forehead, a teal smock flecked with fur tufts, and a strong square build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you, we have a grooming problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑɾɚ ju wi hæv ə ˈɡɹumɪŋ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思打擾你，我們的寵物美容出了狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that face says trouble. What happened?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæt feɪs sɛz ˈtɹʌbəl wʌt həˈpænd/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你的表情寫著麻煩兩個字。發生什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Biscuit came back fluffy from the last place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪskɪt keɪm bæk ˈflʌfi fɹəm ðə læst pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 上週五在別家美容完，Biscuit回家變成一顆毛球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fluffy how? Like a cloud with legs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflʌfi haʊ laɪk ə ˈklaʊd wɪð lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 多毛？像一朵長了腳的雲那樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly that, plus one confused little dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt plʌs wʌn kənˈfjuzɪd ˈlɪɾɚ dɑɡ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣，再加上一隻搞不清狀況的小狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the poodle trim, I've seen this movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈpudəl tɹɪm aɪv sɪn ðɪs ˈmuvi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，貴賓犬剪壞這種戲碼，我見過太多次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We asked for a puppy cut, got a lion.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈæskɪd fɚ ə ˈpʌpi kʌt ɡɑt ə ˈlaɪən/
dialogue.zh: 我們要的明明是可愛小狗造型，結果剪成了一頭獅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oof. Who cut it, if you don't mind my asking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊf hu kʌt ɪt ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd maɪ ˈæskɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哎喲。如果不方便問就算了，是誰幫牠剪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new place, one week open, that's all I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu pleɪs wʌn wik ˈoʊpən ðæts ɔl aɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一間新開的店，才營業一週，我就只知道這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uh huh. So today, what's the rescue plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ hʌ soʊ təˈdeɪ wʌts ðə ˈɹɛsˌkjuz plæn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯哼。那今天，我們的補救計畫是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix him to look like a dog?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju fɪks hɪm tə lʊk laɪk ə dɑɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你們能修整到讓牠看起來像隻正常的狗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can, but honestly, he needs a shave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən bʌt ˈɑnəstli hi nidz ə ʃeɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我可以，但老實說，牠得整個剃短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shave, um, shave how short exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪv ʌm ʃeɪv haʊ ʃɔɹt ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 剃？嗯，剃到多短？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one inch all over, that evens everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn ɪntʃ ɔl ˈoʊvɚ ðæt ˈivənz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 全身大約留一吋，這樣整體就均勻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One inch! He'll look like a different dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪntʃ hil lʊk laɪk ə ˈdɪfɚənt dɑɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一吋！牠會變成另一隻狗吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same dog, fresher coat, calmer tail.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm dɑɡ ˈfɹɛʃɚ koʊt ˈkɑmɚ teɪl/
dialogue.zh: 狗還是那隻狗，只是毛更清爽，尾巴也更自在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, well, okay, you're the expert here.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɛl oʊˈkeɪ jʊɹ ði ˈɛkspɝt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，好吧，這裡你是專家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One concern though, his skin gets red easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kənˈsɝn ðoʊ hɪz skɪn ɡɛts ɹɛd ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 不過有個疑慮，牠的皮膚很容易發紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you know that?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼會知道這件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your face, plus that mat near his belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ feɪs plʌs ðæt mæt nɪɹ hɪz ˈbɛli/
dialogue.zh: 看你的表情，還有牠肚子旁邊那塊打結的毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you spotted that already? Nice eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ju ˈspɑɾɪd ðæt ɔlˈɹɛdi naɪs aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你已經發現了？好眼力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five years of reading nervous pets, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv jɪɹz ɚv ˈɹidɪŋ ˈnɝvəs pɛts hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 五年練出解讀緊張毛小孩的本領，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, will the shave hurt his skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm wɪl ðə ʃeɪv hɝt hɪz skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，剃毛會傷到牠的皮膚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No blade touches skin, we guard with comb.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bleɪd ˈtʌtʃəz skɪn wi ɡɑɹd wɪð koʊm/
dialogue.zh: 刀頭不會碰到皮膚，我們用排梳隔著保護。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the mat? My mom picked it with fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə mæt maɪ mɑm pɪkt ɪt wɪð ˈfɪŋɡɚz/
dialogue.zh: 那塊打結的毛怎麼辦？我媽之前還用手去摳它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, sorry, that pulls skin. We clip it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ ˈsɑɹi ðæt pʊlz skɪn wi klip ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 哎唷，那會扯到皮膚。我們用剪子把它剔下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clip sounds way gentler than pulling.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪp saʊndz weɪ ˈdʒɛnɚ ðæn ˈpʊlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 用剔的聽起來比用手揪溫柔太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. Now, full shave or leave the neck fluff?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz naʊ fʊl ʃeɪv ɔɹ liv ðə nɛk flʌf/
dialogue.zh: 一定輕柔。好，全身剃短，還是留住脖子那圈蓬毛？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, does the fluff make him look younger?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm dʌz ðə flʌf meɪk hɪm lʊk ˈjʌŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，留住那圈毛會讓牠看起來更年輕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much. The lion look came from that fluff.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ðə ˈlaɪən lʊk keɪm fɹəm ðæt flʌf/
dialogue.zh: 會年輕很多。獅子造型就是從那圈毛來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true. Then keep a little, just not lion.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru ðɛn kip ə ˈlɪɾə dʒʌst nɑt ˈlaɪən/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，說得對。那就留一點，但別留成獅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Ears, nails, paws, the full package?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ɪɹz neɪlz pɔz ðə fʊl ˈpækɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。耳朵、指甲、腳掌，全部做一套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, paws too? What happens to the paws?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt pɔz tu wʌt ˈhæpənz tə ðə pɔz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，腳掌也做？腳掌會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We trim the fur between pads, slips less.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi trɪm ðə fɝɹ bɪˈtwin pædz slɪps lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 我們會修剪肉墊之間的毛，牠比較不會打滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, he slides on our kitchen floor daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs hi slaɪdz ɑn ɑɹ ˈkɪtʃən flɔɹ ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，牠每天在我家廚房地板上滑行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic poodle move. Now, want the price first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk ˈpudəl muv naʊ wɑnt ðə pɹaɪs fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 典型貴賓犬動作。那，要先聽報價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, my wallet is hiding already.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz maɪ ˈwɑlət ɪz ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，說吧，我的錢包已經躲起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full shave plus extras, sixty five, no surprises.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ʃeɪv plʌs ˈɛkstrəz ˈsɪksti faɪv noʊ sɚˈpɹaɪzəz/
dialogue.zh: 全身剃短加上其他項目，六十五塊，沒有隱藏費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's better than I feared, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts ˈbɛɾɚ ðæn aɪ fɪrd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這比我擔心的便宜，老實說可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a bath before the shave or after?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə bæθ bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ʃeɪv ɔɹ ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你想要剃毛前洗澡，還是剃完再洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, he hates the dryer, super nervous guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm hi heɪts ðə ˈdɹaɪɚ ˈsuːpɚ ˈnɝvəs ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，牠很害怕吹風機，膽子超小的傢伙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bath first, quiet air dry, no loud blower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn bæθ fɝst ˈkwaɪət ɛɹ draɪ noʊ laʊd ˈbloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那就先洗澡，安靜自然風乾，不開大聲的吹風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're thinking of everything, it's wild.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɚv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɪts waɪld/
dialogue.zh: 你什麼都替牠想到了，太厲害了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wild is my style, ha. Does he take treats?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪld ɪz maɪ staɪl hɑ dʌz hi teɪk trits/
dialogue.zh: 大膽就是我的風格，哈哈。牠平時吃零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Treats? My dog would trade secrets for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /trits maɪ dɑɡ wʊd tɹeɪd ˈsikwɪts fɚ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 零食？我家狗會為了零食出賣同夥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll keep a steady snack supply.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wil kip ə ˈstɛdi snæk səˈplaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們會準備源源不絕的小零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, perfect. Any tricks for nervous shaking?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈpɝfɪkt ˈɛni trɪks fɚ ˈnɝvəs ˈʃeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，完美。那緊張發抖有什麼訣竅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow hands, calm voice, lots of snack bribes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ hændz kɑm vɔɪs lɑts ɚv snæk braɪbz/
dialogue.zh: 動作放慢、聲音放輕，加上多多零食引誘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really enjoy this job, don't you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɹiəli ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðɪs dʒɑb doʊnt ju/
dialogue.zh: 你是真的很享受這份工作，對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do. Short fur, long happiness, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ʃɔɹt fɝɹ lɔŋ ˈhæpinəs hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 是的。毛越短，快樂越長，哈哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until the reveal, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl ðə ɹɪˈvil ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 大概要多久才能看到修整完成的樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, go grab lunch, text when back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊɚz ɡoʊ ɡɹæb lʌntʃ tɛks wɛn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 兩個小時，去吃點午餐，回到附近傳個訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text? I don't have your number, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛks aɪ doʊnt hæv jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息？我沒有你們的電話號碼，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, here's a card, we text from this line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹz ə kɑɹd wi tɛks fɹəm ðɪs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對喔，這是一張名片，我們用這支門號傳訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Oh, can I pick a bandana color?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt oʊ kən aɪ pɪk ə ˌbænˈdənə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。噢，我可以挑一條圍巾的顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have red, blue, and a funny green.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ɹɛd blu ænd ə ˈfʌni ɡɹin/
dialogue.zh: 我們有紅色、藍色，還有一個很有趣的綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green, definitely green, he'll rock it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹin ˈdɛfənəɾli ɡɹin hil ɹɑk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 綠色，一定是綠色，牠絕對能駕馭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green it is, bandana's my treat today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹin ɪt ɪz ˌbænˈdənəz maɪ tɹit təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就綠色，今天圍巾由我請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? Are you sure? I love that.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ɑɹ ju ʃʊɹ aɪ lʌv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 免費？你確定嗎？我太喜歡這樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, two hours then, see you, snack bandit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tu ˈaʊɚz ðɛn si ju snæk ˈbændɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那就兩小時後見，零食大盜。

script.youtube_title_en: "Like a Cloud With Legs" — Asking the Groomer to Fix a Bad Dog Cut
script.youtube_description:
「像一朵長了腳的雲」——上週五美容失敗，今天該怎麼救？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在寵物美容店的工作台邊。

你會聽到：說明上一次造型失敗、詢問能不能剃短修補；談敏感皮膚、打結毛塊怎麼處理；安排洗澡順序避開吵吹風機；再加上腳掌防打滑、指甲、圍巾顏色與報價的完整問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人聊天時的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、uh huh。聽完你就會用：Can you fix him to...、That evens everything、Want the price first、Two hours, go grab lunch。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜看完記得訂閱開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Like a cloud with legs" — last week's dog cut went very wrong, and the groomer desk is where the rescue starts. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a pet grooming salon.

You will hear: explaining a bad trim, asking whether a shave can fix it, discussing sensitive skin and belly mats, choosing the bath order to skip the loud dryer, and covering paw trimming, nails, price, and a free bandana.

Everything stays in A2-level words, full of real spoken texture: um, well, so, ha, uh huh. By the end you'll own phrases like Can you fix him to..., Want the price first?, and Two hours, go grab lunch.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — tap subscribe for a new daily scene.

📌 影片簡介：
上週五帶狗狗去美容，回家卻變成一頭小獅子，敏感皮膚還能剃短嗎？洗澡、吹風、腳掌打滑這些細節，到底怎麼跟美容師講？

這一集帶大家走進寵物美容店，從說明失敗造型、討論剃短與皮膚照護，到安排洗澡順序、加做腳掌與指甲，最後挑一條圍巾道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🐩 說明狀況：We asked for a puppy cut, got a lion.
✂️ 討論補救：Can you fix him to look like a dog?
🛁 安排流程：Um, he hates the dryer, super nervous guy.
💰 談價格：Please, my wallet is hiding already.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、uh huh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著把 Biscuit 的造型救回來，下次帶著你的毛小孩走進美容店，話自然從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你家小狗很快就回到從前帥氣的樣子。
